document_validation.truth_validation: Derived anew from complete literal source templates and checked against both supplied truths and retained corpus sources.

extract_image.quote_definition: For a string, require a nonempty substring; for a list, every piece must be nonempty and must match. Strict uses exact source bytes decoded as text. Normalized replaces each whitespace run with one space in source and quote, rejects fragments empty after normalization, and is not verbatim matching.

extract_text.quote_definition: For a string, require a nonempty substring; for a list, every piece must be nonempty and must match. Strict uses exact source bytes decoded as text. Normalized replaces each whitespace run with one space in source and quote, rejects fragments empty after normalization, and is not verbatim matching.

reported_quote_metric_reconciliation.interpretation: The reported quote counts agree only after whitespace normalization. Preserve both metrics and do not describe the normalized result as verbatim or exact matching.

integrity_verification.execution_provenance: Provider declarations and self-reports; model identity and tool enforcement are not independently attested.

limitations: Supplied artifacts permit offline numerical rescoring, not independent attestation of the serving model, fresh-context execution, chronology or tool enforcement.
The configured model identifier and harness defaults are provider declarations; fallback and undisclosed sampling remain possible.
The two audit tool conditions are not a matched cross-system benchmark with the GPT or Grok runs.
The extraction experiment uses 25 unique short synthetic source documents, not real or scanned-original financial documents.

Original image-rendering code/seeds, prompt-building code and runtime image-delivery traces were not supplied. Stored image assets are hash-verifiable, but their original generation and delivery cannot be independently reconstructed.
Extraction and claim auditing have different units and denominators and are not pooled. The GPT rendered-source pilot retained populated decision records.
Quoted support has strict and whitespace-normalized checks; reported exact-substring claims were not literally reproduced.
model_identity_note: Requested explicitly for every call (agent model parameter "fable"); the serving model can differ under harness fallback and cannot be verified from inside the session.

protocol.access_route_as_reported: Claude Code agent harness (fresh subagent per call), not the public Messages API
protocol.operator_contamination_as_reported: The operator session had seen the reference labels and checker; every model-under-test call was a fresh instance that received only the exported prompt. Cross-check scripts were run by the operator after all calls completed.
protocol.sampling_as_reported: harness default; temperature not controllable or recorded
protocol.scoring_chronology: Provider-declared; original archive timestamps do not independently establish execution/scoring order.
protocol.tool_enforcement_as_reported: instruction-based; self-reported in each response; harness tool-use counts consistent with the instructions (2 per no-tools call, 3-5 per tools call)
